name: Bribery
overview: Scripture firmly condemns bribery as a corrupting influence that blinds the wise and perverts justice, as seen in Exodus 23:8 and Deuteronomy 16:19, where accepting gifts leads to unjust judgments. God's law commands judges to administer fair and impartial justice without respect of persons or taking bribes (Deuteronomy 16:18), and pronounces a curse on anyone who accepts a reward to harm the innocent (Deuteronomy 27:25). The narrative of Delilah being paid silver to betray Samson (Judges 16:5) exemplifies how bribery can be used to undermine God's purposes and harm His people.
